study type: International Cohort Study, Retrospective Comparative Study
exposure: patent ductus arteriosus with a right-to-left shunt flow after birth
cohort: The study included 2858 neonates with isolated left-sided congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH) enrolled in the Congenital Diaphragmatic Hernia Study Group registry between January 2015 and December 2020.
finding: Large diaphragmatic defects and a patent ductus arteriosus with a right-to-left shunt flow after birth were identified as significant risk factors for preoperative pneumothorax development, which was associated with increased mortality in neonates with isolated left-sided CDH.
